findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "review_quote_application" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_quote_link, get_quote_status, attach_quote_document · Private data: list_products, start_quote, get_current_page, answer_quote_page, submit_quote_request, get_missing_questions, answer_additional_questions, attach_quote_document · Public sink: get_quote_link, start_quote, answer_quote_page, submit_quote_request, attach_quote_document · Destructive: answer_quote_page, answer_additional_questions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_quote_link, get_quote_status, attach_quote_document · Private data: list_products, start_quote, get_current_page, answer_quote_page, submit_quote_request, get_missing_questions, answer_additional_questions, attach_quote_document · Public sink: get_quote_link, start_quote, answer_quote_page, submit_quote_request, attach_quote_document · Destructive: answer_quote_page, answer_additional_questions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
